privileged_info_for_vlm: The database is located at /home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook.db. The first month of data (2009-01) should show a Revenue of 35.64 and a NULL or empty MoMGrowthPct. There are 60 distinct months in the dataset. The final CSV must contain exactly 7 columns: Month, Revenue, InvoiceCount, UniqueCustomers, NewCustomers, CumulativeRevenue, and MoMGrowthPct. NewCustomers are defined as customers whose very first invoice date falls within that specific month.
